# CascadeStringReplacement

<Badge type="warning" text="warning" /> <Badge type="tip" text="on by default" /> <Badge type="tip" text="quick-fix" />

Group: [Performance](/rules/#performance) · PhpStorm name: `CascadeStringReplacementInspection`

`str_replace()` accepts arrays of searches and replacements and applies them
in order, so several consecutive replacements on the same subject — written
as back-to-back assignments or as nested calls — can be one call. Also, a
search array whose items are all the same string literal can be that string.

## Example

Short array syntax option on.

::: code-group

```php{5,6,10,11,12} [Before]
<?php
function slug($title, $raw, $line) {
    $title = str_replace('&', 'and', $title);
    /** spaces */
    $title = str_replace(' ', '-', $title);
    return str_replace(['.', ','], '', $title);
}

function others($raw, $line) {
    $code = str_replace('_', '-', str_replace(' ', '_', $raw));
    $mark = str_replace(['k'], ['!'], str_replace('j', '!', $raw));
    $clean = str_replace(array("\t", "\t"), ' ', $line);

    $x = str_replace('a', 'b', $raw);
    $y = str_replace('c', 'd', $x);
    $keep = str_replace(['a', 'b'], 'c', $line);
    log_it(str_replace('q', 'r', str_replace('s', 't', $line)));
    return $y;
}
```

```php [After fix]
<?php
function slug($title, $raw, $line) {
    /** spaces */
    return str_replace(['&', ' ', '.', ','], ['and', '-', '', ''], $title);
}

function others($raw, $line) {
    $code = str_replace([' ', '_'], ['_', '-'], $raw);
    $mark = str_replace(['j', 'k'], '!', $raw);
    $clean = str_replace("\t", ' ', $line);

    $x = str_replace('a', 'b', $raw);
    $y = str_replace('c', 'd', $x);
    $keep = str_replace(['a', 'b'], 'c', $line);
    log_it(str_replace('q', 'r', str_replace('s', 't', $line)));
    return $y;
}
```

:::

Reported:

<ul>
<li>line 5: Fold this str_replace() into the preceding one on the same variable.</li>
<li>line 6: Fold this str_replace() into the preceding one on the same variable.</li>
<li>line 10: Fold this nested str_replace() into the enclosing call.</li>
<li>line 11: Fold this nested str_replace() into the enclosing call.</li>
<li>line 12: All searched items are identical; pass the single string.</li>
</ul>

## Options

| Option | Type | Default | Effect |
|---|---|---|---|
| USE_SHORT_ARRAYS_SYNTAX | bool | false | Array syntax for arrays in the rebuilt call (F5): `[...]` when true, `array(...)` when false. Detection unaffected. Upstream fixtures run with `true`. |

## Configure

In [`custos.json`](/guide/configuration):

```json
{
  "rules": {
    "CascadeStringReplacement": {
      "enabled": false,
      "options": {
        "USE_SHORT_ARRAYS_SYNTAX": false
      }
    }
  }
}
```

## Suppress

Before the statement or declaration (or the first statement of the file), either of:

```php
// @custos-ignore CascadeStringReplacement

/**
 * @noinspection CascadeStringReplacementInspection
 */
```
